name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Authless)
description: A template for deploying remote Model Context Protocol servers on Cloudflare Workers without authentication using Server-Sent Events. It enables users to build and host custom tools accessible from clients like Claude Desktop and the Cloudflare AI Playground.
